1.1: Shelosha asar davar benivlat haof hattahor. tzericha machashava, veenah tzericha hechsher, umetamma tumat ochalin bechabbetza, vechazzayit bevet habbelia, vehaochlah taun heerev shemesh. vechayyavim aleha al biat hammikdash, vesorfin aleha et hatteruma. vehaochel evar min hachay mimmenna sofeg et haarbaim. shechitatah umelikatah metaharot et terefatah, divre rabbi meir. rabbi yehuda omer, enan metaharot. rabbi yose omer, shechitatah metaheret, aval lo melikatah:
1.2: Hakkenafayim vehannotza, mittammeot umetammeot velo mitztarfot. rabbi yishmael omer, hannotza mitztarefet. hachartom vehatztzipparnayim mittammein umetammein umitztarfim. rabbi yose omer, af rashe agappayim verosh hazzanav mitztarfim, shekken mannichim bappetumot:
1.3: Nivlat haof hattame tzericha machashava vehechsher, umetammea tumat ochalin bechabbetza, vechachatzi feras lifsol et haggeviyya, veen bah kazzayit bevet habbelia, vehaochlah en taun heerev shemesh, veen chayyavin aleha al biat mikdash. aval sorfin aleha et hatteruma, vehaochel evar min hachay mimmenna eno sofeg et haarbaim, veen shechitatah metahartah. hakkenafayim vehannotza, mittammeot umetammeot umitztarfot. hachartom vehatztzipparnayim, mittammein umetammeim umitztarfin:
1.4: Uvabbehema, haor veharotev vehakkippa vehaalal vehaatzamot vehaggidim vehakkarnayim vehattelafayim, mitztarfin letamme tumat ochalin, aval lo tumat nevelot. kayyotze vo, hashshochet behema temea lenachri vehi mefarkeset, metammea tumat ochalin, aval lo tumat nevelot, ad shettamut o ad sheyyattiz et roshah. ribba letamme tumat ochalin, mimma sheribba letamme tumat nevelot:
1.5: Haochel shennitma veav hattuma veshennitma vivlad hattuma, mitztarfin ze im ze letamme chakkal shebbishnehen. ketzad. kachatzi vetza ochel rishon vechachatzi vetza ochel sheni shebbelalan ze vaze, sheni. kachatzi vetza ochel sheni vechachatzi vetza ochel shelishi shebbelalan ze vaze, shelishi. kabbetza ochel rishon vechabbetza ochel sheni shebbelalan ze vaze, rishon. chillekan, ze sheni veze sheni. nafal ze leatzmo veze leatzmo al kikkar shel teruma, pesaluhu. naflu shenehen keachat, asauhu sheni:
1.6: Kabbetza ochel sheni vechabbetza ochel shelishi shebbelalan ze vaze, sheni. chillekan, ze shelishi veze shelishi. nafal ze leatzmo veze leatzmo al kikkar shel teruma, lo fesaluhu. naflu shenehen keachat, asauhu shelishi. kabbetza ochel rishon vechabbetza ochel shelishi shebbelalan ze vaze, rishon. chillekan, ze sheni veze sheni, sheaf hashshelishi shennaga barishon naasa sheni. kishte vetzim ochel rishon kishte vetzim ochel sheni shebbelalan ze vaze, rishon. chillekan, ze rishon veze rishon. lishlosha o learbaa, hare ellu sheni. kishte vetzim ochel sheni vechishte vetzim ochel shelishi shebbelalan ze vaze, sheni. chillekan, ze sheni veze sheni. lishlosha o learbaa, hare ellu shelishi:
1.7: Mikratzot noshchot zo vazo, vechikkarim noshchin ze vaze, nitmet achat mehen besheretz, kullan techilla. pershu, kullan techilla. bemashkin, kullan sheniyyot. pershu, kullan sheniyyot. beyadayim, kullan shelishiyyot. pershu, kullan shelishiyyot:
1.8: Mikretzet shehayta techilla vehishshich lah acherot, kullan techillah. pershu, hi techilla vechullan sheniyyot. hayta sheniyya vehishshich lah acherot, kullan sheniyyot. pershu, hi sheniyya vechullan shelishiyyot. hayta shelishit vehishshich lah acherot, hi shelishit vechullan tehorot, ben sheppershu ben shello fershu:
1.9: Kikkerot hakkodesh shebbetoch gummotehem mayim mekuddashim, nitmet achat mehen besheretz, kullan temeot. batteruma, metamme shenayim ufosel echad. im yesh benehem mashke tofeach, af batteruma, hakkol tame:

2.1: Haishsha shehayta choveshet yarak bikdera venaga veale chutz lakkedera vemakom hannaguv, af al pi sheyyesh bo chabbetza, hu tame vehakkol tahor. naga vimkom hammashke, im yesh bo chabbetza, hakkol tame. en bo chabbetza, hu tame vehakkol tahor. chazar lakkedera, hakkol tame. hayta magga teme met venaga, ben bimkom hammashke ben bemakom hannaguv, im yesh bo chabbetza, hakkol tame. en bo chabbetza, hu tame vehakkol tahor. hayta tevulat yom menaeret et hakkedera beyadayim mesoavot, veraata mashkin al yadeha, safek min hakkedera nittezu, safek shehakkelach naga beyadeha, hayyarak pasul vehakkedera tehora:
2.2: Rabbi eliezer omer, haochel ochel rishon, rishon. ochel sheni, sheni. ochel shelishi, shelishi. rabbi yehoshua omer, haochel ochel rishon veochel sheni, sheni. shelishi, sheni lakkodesh velo sheni latteruma, bechullin shennaasu letohorat teruma:
2.3: Harishon shebbachullin, tame umetamme. hashsheni posel velo metamme. vehashshelishi neechol binzid haddama:
2.4: Harishon vehashsheni shebbatteruma temein umetammein. hashshelishi, posel velo metamme. veharvii, neechol binzid hakkodesh:
2.5: Harishon vehashsheni vehashshelishi shebbakkodesh, temein umetammein. harvii, posel velo metamme. vehachamishi, neechol binzid hakkodesh:
2.6: Hashsheni shebbechullin, metamme mashke chullin, ufosel leochale teruma. hashshelishi shebbatteruma, metamme mashke kodesh, ufosel leochale kodesh shennaasu letohorat hakkodesh. aval im naasu letohorat teruma, metamme shenayim ufosel echad bakkodesh:
2.7: Rabbi eliezer omer, shelashtan shavin. haechad shebbakkodesh veshebbatteruma veshebbechullin, metamme shenayim ufosel echad bakkodesh, metamme echad ufosel echad batteruma, ufosel et hachullin. hashsheni shebbechullan, metamme echad ufosel echad bakkodesh, umetamme mashke chullin, ufosel leochale teruma. hashshelishi shebbechullan, metamme mashke kodesh ufosel leochale kodesh:
2.8: Haochel ochel sheni, lo yaase bevet habbad. vechullin shennaasu al gav kodesh, hare ellu chechullin. rabbi elazar bar rabbi tzadok omer, hare ellu chitruma, letamme shenayim velifsol echad:

3.1: Harotev vehaggerisim vehechalav, bizman shehen mashke tofeach, hare ellu techilla. karshu, hare ellu sheniyyim. chazru venimmochu, kabbetza mechuvvan, tahor. yoter mikkabbetza, tame, shekkevan sheyyatza tippa harishona, nitmet bechabbetza:
3.2: Rabbi meir omer, hashshemen techilla leolam. vachachamim omrim, af haddevash. rabbi shimon shezuri omer, af hayyayin. vegush shel zetim shennafal letannur vehussak, kabbetza mechuvvan, tahor. yoter mikkabbetza, tame, shekkevan sheyyatzat tippa harishona, nitmet bechabbetza. im hayu ferudin, afillu hen sea, tahor:
3.3: Teme met shessachat zetim vaanavim, kabbetza mechuvvan, tahor, uvilvad shello yigga bimkom hammashke. yoter mikkabbetza, tame, shekkevan sheyyatza tippa harishona, nitmet bechabbetza. im haya zav o zava, afillu garger yechidi, tame, shekkevan sheyyatza tippa harishona, nitmet bemassa. zav shechalav et haez, hechalav tame, shekkevan sheyyatza tippa harishona, nitmet bemassa:
3.4: Kabbetza ochalin shehinnichan bachamma venitmaatu, vechen kazzayit min hammet, vechazzayit min hannevela, vechaadasha min hashsheretz, kazzayit piggul, kazzayit notar, kazzayit chelev, hare ellu tehorim, veen chayyavin alehen mishshum piggul, notar vetame. hinnichan baggeshamim venitpechu, temein, vechayyavin alehem mishshum piggul, notar vetame:
3.5: Kol hattumot, kishat metziatan. im temeot, temeot. veim tehorot, tehorot. im mechussot, mechussot. im megullot, megullot. machat shennimtzet melea chaludda o shevura, tehora, shekkol hattumot, kishat metziatan:
3.6: Cheresh shote vekatan shennimtzeu vemavoy sheyyesh bo tuma, hare ellu vechezkat tohora. vechol happikkeach, bechezkat tuma. vechol sheen bo daat lehishshael, sefeko tahor:
3.7: Tinok shennimtza vetzad bet hakkevarot vehashshoshannim beyado, veen hashshoshannim ella vimkom hattuma, tahor, sheani omer, acher likketan venatan lo. vechen chamor ben hakkevarot, kelav tehorin:
3.8: Tinok shennimtza vetzad haissa vehabbatzek beyado, rabbi meir metaher. vachachamim metammeim, shedderech hattinok letappeach. batzek sheyyesh bo nekirat tarnegolim, umashkin temein betoch habbayit, im yesh ben mashkin lakkikkarot kede sheyyenaggevu et pihem baaretz, hare ellu tehorin. uvefara uvechelev, kede sheyyelachachu et leshonam. ushear kol habbehema, kede sheyyitnaggev. rabbi eliezer ben yaakov metaher bechelev, shehu fikkeach, sheen darko lehanniach et hammazon velelech lammayim:

4.1: Hazzorek tuma mimmakom lemakom, kikkar leven hammaftechot, mafteach leven hakkikkarot, tahor. rabbi yehuda omer, kikkar leven hammaftechot, tame. mafteach leven hakkikkarot, tahor:
4.2: Hashsheretz befi hachulda umehallechet al gabbe chikkarot shel teruma, safek naga safek lo naga, sefeko tahor:
4.3: Hashsheretz befi hachulda, vehannevela befi hakkelev, veavru ven hattehorim, o sheavru tehorim benehen, sefekan tahor, mippene sheen lattuma makom. hayu menakkerin bahen al haaretz veamar, halachti lammakom hallaz veeni yodea im nagati im lo nagati, sefeko tame, mippene sheyyesh lattuma makom:
4.4: Kazzayit min hammet befi haorev, safek heehil al haadam veal hakkelim birshut hayyachid, sefek adam, tame, sefek kelim, tahor. hamemalle vaasara delayim venimtza sheretz beachad mehen, hu tame vechullan tehorin. hameare mikkeli lichli venimtza sheretz battachton, haelyon tahor:
4.5: Al shishsha sefekot sorfin et hatteruma. al sefek bet happeras, veal sefek afar habba meeretz haammim, al sefek bigde am haaretz, al sefek kelim hannimtzain, al sefek harukkin hannimtzain, al sefek me ragle adam shehen keneged me ragle vehema. al vadday maggaan shehu sefek tumatan, sorfin et hatteruma. rabbi yose omer, af al sefek maggaan birshut hayyachid. vachachamim omrim, birshut hayyachid, tolin. uvirshut harabbim, tahor:
4.6: Shene rukkin, echad tame veechad tahor, tolin al maggaan veal massaan veal hessetan birshut hayyachid, veal maggaan birshut harabbim bizman shehen lachin, veal massaan ben lachin uven yeveshin. haya rok yechidi venaga bo unesao vehissito birshut harabbim, sorfin alav et hatteruma, veen tzarich lomar birshut hayyachid:
4.7: Ellu sefekot shettiharu chachamim. sefek mayim sheuvim lammikve. sefek tuma tzafa al pene hammayim. sefek mashkin, littame, tame, uletamme, tahor. sefek yadayim, littame uletamme velittaher, tahor. sefek reshut harabbim. sefek divre sofrim. sefek hachullin. sefek sheratzim. sefek negaim. sefek nezirut. sefek bechorot. usefek karbanot:
4.8: Sefek tuma tzafa al pene hammayim, ben bakkelim ben bakkarka. rabbi shimon omer, bakkelim, tame. uvakkarka, tahor. rabbi yehuda omer, sefek yeridato, tame. usefek aliyyato, tahor. rabbi yose omer, afillu en sham ella melo adam vetuma, tahor:
4.9: Sefek mashkin littame, tame. ketzad. tame sheppashat et raglo leven mashkin tehorin, safek naga safek lo naga, sefeko tame. hayta chikkar temea beyado uzerakah leven mashkin tehorin, safek naga safek lo naga, sefeko tame. uletamme, tahor. ketzad. hayta makkel beyado uveroshah mashkin temein uzerakah leven kikkarot tehorin, safek naga safek lo naga, sefeko tahor:
4.10: Rabbi yose omer, sefek mashkin, leochalim, tame, ulechelim, tahor. ketzad. shete chaviyyot, achat temea veachat tehora, veasa issa meachat mehen, safek min hattemea asa, safek min hattehora asa, ze hu sefek mashkin leochalin tame ulechelim tahor:
4.11: Sefek yadayim littame uletamme velittaher, tahor. sefek reshut harabbim, tahor. sefek divre sofrim, achal ochalim temeim, shata mashkim temeim, ba rosho verubbo vemayim sheuvin, o shennaflu al rosho verubbo shelosha luggin mayim sheuvim, sefeko tahor. aval davar shehu av hattuma vehu middivre sofrim, sefeko tame:
4.12: Sefek hachullin, zo tohorat perishut. sefek sheratzim, kishat metziatan. sefek negaim, battechilla tahor, ad shello nizkak lattuma. mishshennizkak lattuma, sefeko tame. sefek nezirut, muttar. sefek bechorot, echad bechore adam veechad bechore vehema, ben temea ben tehora, shehammotzi mechavero alav haraya:
4.13: Sefek karbanot, haishsha sheyyesh aleha sefek chamesh ledot usefek chamesh zivot, mevia karban echad, veochelet bazzevachim, veen hashshear aleha chova:

5.1: Hashsheretz vehatztzefardea birshut harabbim, vechen kazzayit min hammet vechazzayit min hannevela, veetzem min hammet veetzem min hannevela, vegush meeretz tehora vegush mibbet happeras, gush meeretz tehora vegush meeretz haammim, shene shevilin, echad tame veechad tahor, halach beachad mehem veen yadua beeze mehen halach, heehil al achad mehem veen yadua al eze mehen heehil, hissit et achad mehem veen yadua eze mehem hissit, rabbi akiva metamme, vachachamim metaharim:
5.2: Echad sheamar, nagati vaze veeni yodea im hu tame veim hu tahor, nagati veeni yodea beeze mishshenehem nagati, rabbi akiva metamme, vachachamim metaharim. rabbi yose metamme vechullan, umetaher bashshevil, shedderech bene adam lahaloch veen darkam ligga:
5.3: Shene shevilim, echad tame veechad tahor, halach beachad mehem veasa tohorot veneechlu, hizza veshana vetaval vetahar, vehalach bashsheni veasa tohorot, hare ellu tehorot. im kayyamot harishonot, ellu vaellu teluyot. im lo tahar bentayim, harishonot teluyot vehashsheniyyot yissarefu:
5.4: Hashsheretz vehatztzefardea birshut harabbim, naga beachad mehem veasa tohorot veneechlu, taval, naga bashsheni veasa tohorot, hare ellu tehorot. im kayyamot harishonot, ellu vaellu teluyot. im lo taval bentayim, harishonot teluyot vehashsheniyyot yissarefu:
5.5: Shene shevilin, echad tame veechad tahor, halach beachad mehen veasa tohorot, uva chavero vehalach bashsheni veasa tohorot, rabbi yehuda omer, im nishalu ze vifne atzmo veze vifne atzmo, tehorin. veim nishalu shenehem keechad, temeim. rabbi yose omer, ben kach uven kach, temeim:
5.6: Shene chikkarim, echad tame veechad tahor, achal et achad mehem veasa tohorot uva chavero veachal et hashsheni veasa tohorot, rabbi yehuda omer, im nishalu ze vifne atzmo veze vifne atzmo, tehorin. veim nishalu shenehen keachat, temeim. rabbi yose omer, ben kach uven kach, temeim:
5.7: Mi sheyyashav birshut harabbim uva echad vedaras al begadav, o sherakak venaga berukko, al rukko sorfim et hatteruma, veal begadav holchin achar harov. yashen birshut harabbim veamad, kelav temeim midras, divre rabbi meir. vachachamim metaharin. naga beechad ballayla, veen yadua im chay im met, uvashshachar amad umetzao met, rabbi meir metaher. vachachamim metammeim, shekkol hattumot kishat metziatan:
5.8: Shota achat bair, o nachrit, o chutit, kol harukkim shebbair temein. mi sheddarsa ishsha al begadav, o sheyyashva immo bisfina, im makkirato shehu ochel batteruma, kelav tehorin. veim lav, yishalenna:
5.9: Ed omer nitma, vehu omer lo nitmeti, tahor. shenayim omrim nitmeta, vehu omer lo nitmeti, rabbi meir metamme. vachachamim omrim, hu neeman al yede atzmo. ed omer nitma, ushenayim omrim lo nitma, ben birshut hayyachid ben birshut harabbim, tahor. shenayim omrim nitma, veed omer lo nitma, ben birshut hayyachid ben birshut harabbim, tame. ed omer nitma veed omer lo nitma, ishsha omeret nitma veishsha omeret lo nitma, birshut hayyachid, tame. birshut harabbim, tahor:

6.1: Makom shehaya reshut hayyachid venaasa reshut harabbim, chazar venaasa reshut hayyachid, keshehu reshut hayyachid, sefeko tame. keshehu reshut harabbim, sefeko tahor. hamesukkan birshut hayyachid vehotziuhu lirshut harabbim, vehecheziruhu lirshut hayyachid, keshehu virshut hayyachid, sefeko tame. keshehu virshut harabbim, sefeko tahor. rabbi shimon omer, reshut harabbim mafsaket:
6.2: Arbaa sefekot rabbi yehoshua metamme vachachamim metaharin. ketzad. hattame omed vehattahor over, hattahor omed vehattame over, hattuma virshut hayyachid vetohora virshut harabbim, tohora virshut hayyachid vetuma virshut harabbim, safek naga safek lo naga, safek heehil safek lo heehil, safek hissit safek lo hissit, rabbi yehoshu metamme, vachachamim metaharin:
6.3: Ilan shehu omed birshut harabbim vehattuma vetocho, ala lerosho, safek naga safek lo naga, sefeko tame. hichnis yado lechor sheyyesh bo tuma, safek naga safek lo naga, sefeko tame. chanut shehu tame ufatuach lirshut harabbim, safek nichnas safek lo nichnas, sefeko tahor. safek naga safek lo naga, sefeko tahor. shete chanuyyot, echad tame veechad tahor, nichnas leachad mehen, safek lattame nichnas safek lattahor nichnas, sefeko tame:
6.4: Kol sheatta yachol lerabbot sefekot usefek sefekot, birshut hayyachid, tame. birshut harabbim, tahor. ketzad, nichnas lemavoy vehattuma vechatzer, safek nichnas safek lo nichnas, tuma babbayit, safek nichnas safek lo nichnas, vaafillu nichnas, safek hayta sham safek lo hayta sham, vaafillu hayta sham, safek sheyyesh bah kashshiur safek sheen bah kashshiur, vaafillu sheyyesh bah, safek tuma safek tohora, vaafillu tuma, safek naga safek lo naga, sefeko tame. rabbi elazar omer, sefek bia, tahor. sefek magga tuma, tame:
6.5: Nichnas levika bimot haggeshamim, vetuma besade felonit, veamar, halachti lammakom hallaz veeni yodea im nichnasti leoto hassade veim lo nichnasti, rabbi elazar metaher, vachachamim metammein:
6.6: Sefek reshut hayyachid, tame, ad sheyyomar lo nagati. sefek reshut harabbim tahor, ad sheyyomar nagati. ezo hi reshut harabbim. shevile vet gilgul, vechen kayyotze vahen, reshut hayyachid leshabbat, ureshut harabbim lattuma. amar rabbi elazar, lo huzkeru shevile vet gilgul, ella shehem reshut hayyachid lechach ulechach. hashshevilim hamefullashim levorot uleshichim velimarot ulegittot, reshut hayyachid leshabbat ureshut harabbim lattuma:
6.7: Habbika, bimot hachamma, reshut hayyachid leshabbat ureshut harabbim lattuma. uvimot haggeshamim, reshut hayyachid lechach ulechach:
6.8: Basilki, reshut hayyachid lashshabbat ureshut harabbim lattuma. rabbi yehuda omer, im omed hu vappetach hazze veroe et hannichnasin veet hayyotzin bappetach hallaz, reshut hayyachid lechach ulechach. veim lav, reshut hayyachid lashshabbat ureshut harabbim lattuma:
6.9: Happaran, reshut hayyachid lashshabbat ureshut harabbim lattuma. vechen hatztzedadin. rabbi meir omer, hatztzedadin, reshut hayyachid lechach ulechach:
6.10: Haistevanit, reshut hayyachid lashshabbat ureshut harabbim lattuma. chatzer sheharabbim nichnasim bazo veyotzim bazo, reshut hayyachid lashshabbat ureshut harabbim lattuma:

7.1: Hakkaddar shehinniach et kederotav veyarad lishtot, happenimiyyot tehorot, vehachitzonot temeot. amar rabbi yose, bamme devarim amurim, bemuttarot. aval baagudot, hakkol tahor. hammoser maftecho leam haaretz, habbayit tahor, shello masar lo ella shemirat hammafteach:
7.2: Hammanniach am haaretz betoch beto er umetzao er, yashen umetzao yashen, er umetzao yashen, habbayit tahor, yashen umetzao er, habbayit tame, divre rabbi meir. vachachamim omrim, en tame ella ad mekom shehu yachol lifshot et yado veligga:
7.3: Hammanniach ummanim betoch beto, habbayit tame, divre rabbi meir. vachachamim omrim, en tame ella ad mekom shehen yecholin lifshot et yadam veligga:
7.4: Eshet chaver shehinnicha leeshet am haaretz tochenet betoch betah, paska harechayim, habbayit tame. lo faska harechayim, en tame ella ad mekom shehi yechola lifshot et yadah veligga. hayu shetayim, ben kach uven kach, habbayit tame, sheachat tochenet veachat meshammeshet, divre rabbi meir. vachachamim omrim, en tame ella ad mekom shehen yecholin lifshot et yadan veligga:
7.5: Hammanniach am haaretz betoch beto leshamro, bizman shehu roe et hannichnasin veet hayyotzin, hoochalim vehammashkim uchele cheres happetuchim, temeim. aval hammishkavot vehammoshavot uchele cheres hammukkafin tzamid patil, tehorin. veim eno roe lo et hannichnasin velo et hayyotzin, afillu muval, afillu chafut, hakkol tame:
7.6: Haggabbaim shennichnesu letoch habbayit, habbayit tame. im yesh immahen goy, neemanim lomar lo nichnasnu, aval en neemanim lomar nichnasnu aval lo naganu. haggannavim shennichnesu letoch habbayit, en tame ella mekom ragle haggannavim. uma hen metammein. hoochalim vehammashkim uchele cheres happetuchin. aval hammishkavot vehammoshavot uchele cheres hammukkafin tzamid patil, tehorim. im yesh immahen nachri o ishsha, hakkol tame:
7.7: Hammanniach et kelav bechallon shel odyarin, rabbi elazar ben azarya metaher. vachachamim omrim, ad sheyyitten lo et hammafteach o chotam o ad sheyyaase siman. hammanniach et kelav miggat zo laggat habbaa, kelav tehorin. uveyisrael, ad sheyyomar belibbi haya leshamram:
7.8: Mi shehaya tahor, vehissia et libbo milleechol, rabbi yehuda metaher, shedderech temein porshin mimmenu. vachachamim metammeim. hayu yadav tehorot vehissia et libbo milleechol, af al pi sheamar yodea ani shello nitmeu yaday, yadav temeot, shehayyadayim askaniyyot:
7.9: Haishsha shennichnesa lehotzi fat leani, veyatzat umetzaattu omed betzad kikkarot shel teruma, vechen haishsha sheyyatzat umatzat et chavertah chota gechalim tachat kedera shel teruma, rabbi akiva metamme, vachachamim metaharin. amar rabbi elazar ben pila, vechi mippene ma rabbi akiva metamme vachachamim metaharin. mippene shehannashim gargeraniyyot hen, shehi chashuda legallot et hakkedera shel chavertah, leda ma hi mevashshelet:

8.1: Haddar im am haaretz bechatzer, veshachach kelim bechatzer, afillu chaviyyot mukkafot tzamid patil, o tannur mukkaf tzamid patil, hare ellu temein. rabbi yehuda metaher betannur bizman shehu mukkaf tzamid patil. rabbi yose omer, af hattannur tame, ad sheyyaase lo mechitztza gavoah asara tefachim:
8.2: Hammafkid kelim etzel am haaretz, temeim teme met utemein midras. im makkiro shehu ochel batteruma, tehorin mitteme met, aval temein midras. rabbi yose omer, im masar lo teva melea vegadim, bizman shehi rotzetzet, temein midras. im enah rotzetzet, temein maddaf, af al pi shehammafteach beyad habbealim:
8.3: Hameabbed bayyom umatza vayyom, tahor. bayyom umatza vallayla, ballayla umatza vayyom, bayyom umatza vayyom shelleacharav, tame. ze hakkelal, kol sheyyaavor alav hallayla o miktzato, tame. hashshoteach kelim, birshut harabbim, tehorin. uvirshut hayyachid, temein. veim haya meshammeran, tehorim. naflu vehalach lahavian, temeim. nafal dalyo letoch boro shel am haaretz vehalach lehavi vema yaalennu, tame, mippene shehunnach birshut am haaretz shaa echat:
8.4: Hammanniach et beto fatuach umetzao fatuach, naul umetzao naul, patuach umetzao naul, tahor. naul umetzao fatuach, rabbi meir metamme, vachachamim metaharin, shehayu gannavim venimlechu vehalchu lahen:
8.5: Eshet am haaretz shennichnesa letoch beto shel chaver lehotzi veno o vitto o vehemto, habbayit tahor, mippene shennichnesa shello virshut:
8.6: Kelal amru vattohorot, kol hameyuchad leochel adam, tame, ad sheyyippasel meochel hakkelev. vechol sheeno meyuchad leochel adam, tahor, ad sheyyeyachadennu leadam. ketzad. gozal shennafal legat vechishshav alav lehaaloto lenachri, tame. lechelev, tahor. rabbi yochanan ben nuri metamme. chishshav alav cheresh, shote vekatan, tahor. im heelahu, tame, sheyyesh lahen maase veen lahen machashava:
8.7: Achore chelim shennitmeu vemashkim, rabbi eliezer omer, metammein et hammashkin veen poslin et hoochalin. rabbi yehoshua omer, metammein et hammashkin ufoslin et hoochalin. shimon achi azarya omer, lo chach velo chach, ella mashkin shennitmeu vaachore hakkelim, metammein echad ufoslin echad. hare ze omer, metammeecha lo timmeuni, veatta timmetani:
8.8: Areva shehi ketafres, vehabbatzek millemalan umashke tofeach millemattan, shalosh chatichot bechabbetza, enan mitztarfot. ushetayim, mitztarfot. rabbi yose omer, af shetayim enan mitztarfot, ella im ken hayu rotztzot mashke. veim haya mashke omed, afillu cheen hachardal, mitztaref. rabbi dosa omer, ochel parud eno mitztaref:
8.9: Makkel shehi melea mashkin temein, kevan shehishshikah lammikve, tehora, divre rabbi yehoshua. vachachamim omrim, ad sheyyatbil et kullah. hannitztzok vehakketafres umashke tofeach, enan chibbur lo lattuma velo lattohora. vehaeshboren, chibbur lattuma velattohora:

9.1: Zetim meematay mekabbelin tuma. mishsheyyazziu zeat hammaatan, aval lo zeat hakkuppa, kedivre vet shammay. rabbi shimon omer, shiur zea shelosha yamim. bet hillel omrim, mishsheyyitchabberu shelosha ze laze. rabban gamliel omer, mishshettiggamer melachtan. vachachamim omrim kidvarav:
9.2: Gamar millimsok aval atid likkach, gamar millikkach aval atid lilvot, ero evel, o mishte, o ones, afillu zavim vezavot mehallechim alehen, tehorin. naflu alehen mashkin temein, en tame ella mekom maggaan, vehammochal hayyotze mehen tahor:
9.3: Nigmera melachtan, hare ellu muchsharin. naflu alehen mashkin, temein. hammochal hayyotze mehen, rabbi eliezer metaher, vachachamim metammein. amar rabbi shimon, lo nechleku al hammochal hayyotze min hazzetim, shehu tahor. veal ma nechleku. al hayyotze min habbor, sherabbi eliezer metaher, vachachamim metammein:
9.4: Haggomer et zetav veshiyyer kuppa achat, yittenenna leani hakkohen, divre rabbi meir. rabbi yehuda omer, yolich et hammafteach miyyad. rabbi shimon omer, meet leet:
9.5: Hammanniach zetim bakkotesh sheyyimtonu sheyyehu nochin lichtosh, hare ellu muchsharim. sheyyimtonu sheyyimlachem, bet shammay omrim, muchsharim. uvet hillel omrim, enan muchsharim. happotzea zetim beyadayim temeot, timmean:
9.6: Hammanniach zetav baggag legargeram, afillu hen rum amma, enan muchsharim. netanan babbayit sheyyilku veatid lehaalotam laggag, netanan baggag sheyyilku o sheyyiftechem, hare ellu muchsharin. netanan babbayit ad sheyyeshammer et gaggo o ad sheyyolichem lemakom acher, enan muchsharin:
9.7: Ratza littol mehen bad echad o shene vaddin, bet shammay omrim, kotze vetuma umechappe vetohora. bet hillel omrim, af mechappe vetuma. rabbi yose omer, chofer bekardummot shel mattechet umolich levet habbad betuma:
9.8: Hashsheretz shennimtza varechayim, en tame ella mekom maggao. im haya mashke mehallech, hakkol tame. nimtza al gabbe healim, yishshaalu habbaddadim lomar lo naganu. im haya nogea baom, afillu vesaara, tame:
9.9: Nimtza al gabbe ferudim, vehu nogea bechabbetza, tame. perudim al gabbe ferudim, af al pi shehu nogea bechabbetza, en tame ella mekom maggao. nimtza ven kotel lazzetim, tahor. nimtza vaggag, hammaatan tahor. nimtza vammaatan, haggag tame. nimtza saruf al hazzetim, vechen matlit mehuha, tehora, shekkol hattumot kishat metziatan:

10.1: Hannoel bet habbad mippene habbaddadin vehayu lesham kelim temein midras, rabbi meir omer, bet habbad tame. rabbi yehuda omer, bet habbad tahor. rabbi shimon omer, im tehorin lahen, bet habbad tame. veim temein lahen, bet habbad tahor. amar rabbi yose, vechi mippene ma temeot, ella sheen amme haaretz bekiin behesset:
10.2: Habbaddadin shehayu nichnasin veyotzin, umashkin temein betoch bet habbad, im yesh ben mashkin lazzetim kede sheyyenaggevu et raglehem baaretz, hare ellu tehorin. habbaddadin vehabbotzrin shennimtzet tuma lifnehem, neemanin lomar lo naganu. vechen hattinokot shebbenehem, yotzim chutz lefetach bet habbad ufonin laachore haggader, vehen tehorin. ad kamma yarchiku veyihyu tehorin, ad kede sheyyehe roan:
10.3: Habbaddadin vehabbotzrin, kevan shehichnisan lirshut hammeara, dayyo, divre rabbi meir. rabbi yose omer, tzarich laamod alehen ad sheyyitbolu. rabbi shimon omer, im tehorin lahen, tzarich laamod alehem ad sheyyitbolu. im temeim lahen, eno tzarich laamod alehem ad sheyyitbolu:
10.4: Hannoten min hassallim umin hammashteach shel adama, bet shammay omrim, noten beyadayim tehorot. veim natan beyadayim temeot, timmean. bet hillel omrim, noten beyadayim temeot, umafrish terumato betohora. min haavat umin hammashteach shel alim, hakkol shavim shehu noten beyadayim tehorot. veim natan beyadayim temeot, timmean:
10.5: Haochel min hassallim umin hammashteach shel adama, af al pi shemmevukkaot umenattefot laggat, hare haggat tehora. min haavat umin hammashteach shel alim venafal mimmennu garger yechidi, im yesh lo chotam, tahor. im en lo chotam, tame. naflu mimmennu anavim uderachan bemakom hammufne, kabbetza mechuvvan, tahor. yoter mikkabbetza, tame, shekkevan sheyyatzat tippa harishona, nitmet bechabbetza:
10.6: Mi shehaya omed umedabber al sefat habbor venitteza tzinnora mippiv, safek higgia labbor safek lo higgia, sefeko tahor:
10.7: Hazzolef et habbor, nimtza sheretz barishona, kullan temeot. baacharona, hi temea vechullan tehorot. ematay, bizman shehu zolef bechol achat veachat. aval im haya zolef bemachatz, nimtza sheretz beachat mehen, hi temea bilvad. ematay, bizman shehu vodek velo mechasse o mechasse velo vodek. haya vodek umechasse, venimtza sheretz, bechavit, hakkol tame. babbor, hakkol tame. bammachatz, hakkol tame:
10.8: Ben haiggulim lazzaggin, reshut harabbim. kerem shellifne habbotzrim, reshut hayyachid. shelleachar habbotzrim, reshut harabbim. ematay, bizman sheharabbim nichnasim bazo veyotzim bazo. kele vet habbad, veshel gat, vehaekel, bizman shehen shel etz, menaggevan vehen tehorin. bizman shehen shel gemi, meyashshenan kol shenem asar chodesh, o choltan bechammim. rabbi yose omer, im netanan beshibbolet hannahar, dayyo:
